experiment: Mahakal neural-physics feasibility, manufactured problems only
scope: CPU controlled simulations, not Kerr geodesics, not repaired production maps, not a reproduction of BH-NeRF, PI-DEF, FNO or the Kiran runtime

sources: same source plus compact old transient violating source-free advection
models: same field plus advection PINN loss
inverse.old_metric: relative L2 error of contrast j-1, not baseline-dominated j

forward.non_neural_comparator: cubic spline in log(x) on same labels
forward.detector_metric: actual integrated cos(3*tau) on 12 log-spaced screen pixels with area whitening

operator_learning.family: linear periodic advection, 4 Fourier modes, velocity 0.8
operator_learning.model: low-rank Fourier-input neural operator with learned continuous temporal multipliers; not a full FNO implementation
models: coarse data plus differential residual at fine time points
operator_learning.out_of_basis_test: sixth Fourier mode explicitly not represented

routing.scope: Kiran-inspired bounded support access, not Kiran model deployment
routing.destructive_control: drop two of four nonzero geometric contributions
routing.claim: algebraic equivalence and approximation error, not measured production speedup

mathematical_checks: data and PDE invariant to compensating common-delay/source-time shift
shared biased labels cannot certify a forward surrogate
preservation: No production code or maps changed, no paid resources, no production ray budget used
evaluation: Record all fixed candidates and seeds including failures; no sealed-main or publication-readiness claim
